Completeness of vaccination dates

Source: R/report.R
date_completeness.Rd

Of the doses documented on a card, how many carry a date, and how many carry a date complete enough to compute age at vaccination.

date_completeness(x, by = NULL)

Arguments

x

A vcs_data object.

by

Grouping variables, drawn from the child-level table.

Value

A tibble with n_documented, n_dated, prop_dated, n_partial and prop_partial per group.

Examples

date_completeness(vcs_example)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 5
#>   n_documented n_dated n_partial prop_dated prop_partial
#>          <int>   <int>     <int>      <dbl>        <dbl>
#> 1         1346    1161       104      0.863       0.0773
date_completeness(vcs_example, by = ~vaccine)
#> # A tibble: 14 × 6
#>    n_documented n_dated n_partial prop_dated prop_partial vaccine

#>  4          102      88         7      0.863      0.0686  OPV0
